headline: Gibraltar needs more than 1,063 feet — build it now
body:
That climb bites: 1,063 feet in 15 miles is your steepest ride since Sunday 9/6, and it pushes this week to 26.2 miles and 1,428 feet already — the best week since early September. Good. But be honest about the gap. Three weeks of 8.1, 15.7 and now 26.2 miles sit well under what 62 miles asks, and your longest ride all season is 27.7 miles. On climbing you're further back: your biggest day is 1,819 feet, and Gibraltar alone is 2,551 in one 6.1-mile push, inside a 6,600-foot route. With 17 days left, the priority is one long ride with real foothill climbing, not more flat spins.

Thursday is the pick for volume — 74°F and light wind. Friday at 84°F, go short or rest. Saturday through Tuesday run 88–90°F with lows near 76, so ride at sunrise (6:55) and keep the hot afternoons off the bike.
